constructionControl: Three rotated/reversed arms per trial: original eager cold construction, new shared-index path with empty caches, and a fork of the primed shared-index session. All include fresh placement; only the fork includes cloning. Complete scenes, fixed routes, delegation, keys, conflicts and deterministic constructor counters match. Fresh control separates shared preparation from warm geometry/clearance/planning reuse; final repair reuse is disabled.
constructionReuseContract: Fixed-path endpoint/flow preparation omits per-edge search obstacles and indexes. One fresh inflated-box index is shared by the final construction. Exact start/end, orientation, logical reversal and ordered corners key each path geometry. Fresh segment-box queries collect all potentially intersecting non-excluded inflated obstacles; exact identity/rectangle keys gate clearance-decision reuse, including prior obstacle rejection. Endpoint/ancestor exclusions are refreshed. Track acceptance always scans current assigned routes in graph order, never replays acceptance. Coordination, growth, fallback, final repair and scoring remain fresh. Cold path is the original eager preparation, not the new path with an empty cache; totals combine preparation sharing, exact cache reuse and planning reuse.
note: One warmup, rotating/reversed candidate order and alternating cold/cached measurements (three rotated arms in the construction control). Each candidate starts from the same immutable input and forks the base planning session, not the preceding trial's keys; cloning cost is included. Only its target frame is placed; positive size changes push dependent siblings/ancestors using the existing growth helper, without shrinking frames or reordering ancestors. Changed border dependencies are routed afresh. Totals include local placement/propagation and complete global growth/routing/repair/labels/scoring; exclude import and transport. No general route or score cache; optional fixed-path geometry/clearance reuse or exact fixed-track decision reuse is disclosed separately. Cold/cached scene/key/conflict identity checked; full hard/track/geometry/routing eligibility required for diagnostic improvement. No publication or production refinement change.
selection: First adjacent real-sibling swap in each non-root area in stable area/rank order, at most eight. No proxy pruning, no production portfolio change.
